entities.summary: Volodymyr Shashkevych (b. 1839-04-07, Radekhiv Raion) was a journalist or media commentator of the Modern era, defined by industrialization, revolution, and global conflict, active in Radekhiv Raion. Known in the fields of poets & playwrights.
